title: Weekly limit reached ∙ resets 6pm

top_comments.author: hobbio
top_comments.body: I really like claude code , I might be agree with weekly limits policy but, limit consumption is insane, i understand the need to prevent abuse but ... I hope claude is measuring the consumption incorrectly and a fix soon , maybe not a reversal of the policy but weekly consumption calculation is terribly wrong
